about: Constants shared by the combat systems. Each is { value, unit, fs2 or source }: 'fs2' names FS2's own value (checked by tools/combat/check_weapons.py where it is a table field), 'source' says why it is ours (design section 5 and 4). Tuned by feel in the combat range; the user's playtests overrule.

shieldRegenPerSecond.unit: fraction of max per second at balanced power
shieldRegenPerSecond.source: ours: an empty bubble refills in 25 s at balanced power, 14 s favouring shields, 42 s starving them (FS2's quadrants regenerate on a similar scale)

shieldRegenDelay.source: ours: a bubble under fire does not refill

shieldBubbleScale.source: ours: FS2's $Shields is the total of four quadrants and fire lands mostly on one; one bubble at half the total takes about twice as long to break as one quadrant, which keeps a fight a few seconds long

weaponEnergyLevel.source: FS2 hudets.cpp Energy_levels[4]: the default balanced setting gives each system a third of the ship's power output (weapon energy per second = $Power Output x this)

powerFavoured.source: ours: FS2's 6-3-3 split gives 1.5x and 0.75x; widened so a single pick is felt (design section 5: a split-second call)

powerEngineSpeedBonus.source: ours: engines favoured adds a little speed (design section 5)

powerEngineAfterburnerBoost.source: ours: engines favoured also refills the afterburner faster (not yet used by Flight)

healDelay.source: ours: design section 5: self-healing starts after a few seconds without taking damage

healHullPerSecond.unit: fraction of max hull per second
healHullPerSecond.source: ours: 0.8% a second, 2 minutes for a full hull: never fast enough to tank a fight

healPartPerSecond.unit: fraction of max part hp per second
healPartPerSecond.source: ours: damaged parts mend; destroyed parts never do (they need a hand repair, a cabin piece)

partDamagedBelow.source: ours: matches ShipSubsystem.SetHealth's default 'damaged look' threshold

partReach.source: ours: a hit on the hull damages the nearest part within this many radii of the impact

engineLimpFraction.source: ours: a fighter whose engines are all destroyed crawls at 30%; capital ships drift (0)

reactorDownEnergy.source: ours: a destroyed reactor starves the weapons and kills the shield

collisionEnergyToDamage.unit: hp per joule lost in the contact
collisionEnergyToDamage.source: ours: tuned so a 12-tonne fighter hitting a capital hull at 40 m/s loses about 110 hp, 15 m/s about 15 hp (a graze hurts, does not kill) and 70 m/s kills

collisionMinSeparation.source: ours: after a contact the ships part at least this fast, so a graze does not become a scrape

collisionPairCooldown.source: ours: the same two ships do not take collision damage twice inside this

collisionMaxKnockSpeed.source: ours: the biggest speed change one contact gives a ship

collisionMinClosing.source: ours: slower than this is touching, not hitting

warningRange.source: ours: hostile missiles inside this are reported by the missile warning

lockLoseSeconds.source: ours: a lock survives the target leaving the cone this long

lockDecayMultiplier.source: ours: a lock being built drains this much faster than it builds when the target leaves the cone

missileMinArmTime.source: ours: a missile cannot detonate on its own launcher in its first moments

missileTrackLoseSeconds.source: ours: a heat seeker whose target leaves its view cone flies straight after this long (dodging works)

gunConvergenceRange.source: ours: with no target the guns converge here

flakProximity.source: ours: a flak shell bursts when it passes this near a hostile hull
